idea-plugin.name: Atlas Ragnarok
idea-plugin.description:
Atlas Ragnarok

Tech-blue thunder above. Crimson fire below. Pure black through the middle.

The end-of-days color scheme for IntelliJ-platform IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand, WebStorm, Rider, RustRover, CLion, RubyMine, PhpStorm, DataGrip, Android Studio).

Built on the syntactic structure of Vesper, with the warm-accent family remapped to a Tailwind blue gradient and a pure-black background.

Activate via Settings → Editor → Color Scheme → Atlas Ragnarok.

Source & ports for other editors
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Full editor color scheme: keywords, types, strings, numbers, comments, doc comments, brackets, operators, identifiers, tags, attributes, decorators.
  • VCS file-status colors aligned with the palette (added/modified/deleted/ignored/conflict).
  • Bracket-match + identifier-under-caret highlights tuned for OLED contrast.
